summary.text: Son of Ctimenus or of Irus and Demonassa, Argonaut from the region of Lake Xynius.

story.text: Apollodorus and Hyginus count Eurydamus among the crew; Hyginus makes him son of Irus and Demonassa, or of Ctimenus near Lake Xynius.

Apollodorus and Hyginus place Eurydamus near Lake Xynius in Dolopia — a highland region, not a named polis in either catalogue. No source assigns him to a specific town on our map; residence stays deferred at regional level.
